issues.desc: background.md Key Insights mentions "the anchorFiles added in B-a2e3" without a one-sentence explanation of what B-a2e3 is (its title or scope). A standalone reader cannot infer whether B-a2e3 is a previous story, an external dependency, or something else. Similarly, Solution Tradeoffs references "B-a2e3s revalidateSignals leaf" with the same missing context. Per Dimension 2, cross-story references should have a one-sentence explanation on first appearance.

CHK items prove the cache is written and tests pass, but no checklist item demonstrates an actual review hint firing after the scan (the claimed user-visible payoff). The hint-injection smoke from Phase 1.5 exists independently, so this is advisory, not blocking — but an end-to-end step showing scan->hint-fires would close the product loop more convincingly.
